extendReasons.title: Sleep well, still meet people
extendReasons.description: Privacy pods give you a reset button after a long day in the mountains, so the social side of hostel life stays a choice, not a chore.

extendReasons.title: Rooftop nights, zero pressure
extendReasons.description: Sunset views, easy conversation, and movie nights make it simple to connect without the space ever feeling chaotic. It’s social, but at your own pace.

extendReasons.title: Everything starts right outside
extendReasons.description: You’re already on Shkoder's main pedestrian street, surrounded by local eats, museums, and nightlife. Whether you're heading to the Alps or the coast, transport is just a short walk away.

extendReasons.title: Staff who keep things straightforward
extendReasons.description: Honest local tips, breakfast that guests talk about, and help with your hiking route. We handle the logistics so you can focus on the trip.

experiencePillars.title: Your Adventure Basecamp
experiencePillars.description: Drop your heavy bags and get out there. We’ll help you sort the logistics for the Theth and Valbona trek, boat trips up the Shala River, and kayaking out on Lake Shkodër.
experiencePillars.alt: Hiking and mountain views near Shkoder, Albanian Alps trips from Scodrinon Hostel

experiencePillars.title: Right in the Center
experiencePillars.description: Step out our front door directly onto Kolë Idromeno, Shkodër’s main pedestrian street. From your first morning espresso to late-night drinks, the city's best food, culture, and rhythm are literally at your doorstep.
experiencePillars.alt: Pedestrian street scene near Scodrinon Hostel on Kolë Idromeno, Shkoder

featuredMoments.title: River Days at the Drin
featuredMoments.description: We head out to the river regularly for swimming and sun. These trips are a hostel favorite — a chance to see a different side of Shkoder and spend the afternoon with a great crew.
featuredMoments.alt: Guests enjoying an evening event at Scodrinon Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Spontaneous Socials
featuredMoments.description: Whether it’s rooftop raki or a local food crawl, we prioritize warm, unscripted moments that make it easy for solo travelers to join. It’s social, but never forced.
featuredMoments.alt: Traditional food event at Scodrinon Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Explore the Bicycle Capital
featuredMoments.description: Shkodër runs on two wheels. Grab a rental and explore the city's flat streets, lake paths, and cafes exactly how the locals do.
featuredMoments.alt: Bike tour event from Scodrinon Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Rooftop Magic
featuredMoments.description: The rooftop is the social heart of the hostel: mountain light at sunset, city views after dark, and a pace that feels relaxed from the first drink to the last chat.
featuredMoments.alt: Guests relaxing on the Scodrinon Hostel rooftop at sunset
